integrity: Standalone elementary double counting, published pair-distance identity explicitly attributed, finite verifiers included; not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact histogram only for t=3; moment formulas n>=t>=1; Gaussian limit only fixed t and n/q->positive finite constant. Uniform multiset law is distinct from iid-symbol distribution. Priority subject to unindexed earlier work.
title: Three-deletion descendant-volume spectrum and a Gaussian law for random multisets
